title: Wing Commander 3 gets a 30th anniversary edition 🚀
subject: wingcommander
description:
Did you play Wing Commander 3 back in the day? 👇

EA producer Jim Vessella announced Wing Commander 3: 30th Anniversary Edition at the Portland Retro Gaming Expo. The remaster restores the classic's full-motion video, starring Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell and John Rhys-Davies, from recovered original tapes, adds up to 60fps and a fan-made enhancement patch. No release date or platforms yet.

Sources: VGC (Oct 12, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 11, 2026), Wikipedia

scenes.text: Wing Commander 3 is getting a 30th anniversary edition.
EA producer Jim Vessella revealed it at the Portland Retro Gaming Expo.
The 1994 classic's live-action scenes starred Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell and John Rhys-Davies.
Back then, they ran at 240p and were heavily compressed.
Now EA has recovered much of the original source video and is restoring it.
It also adds up to 60 frames per second and a fan-made enhancement patch. No release date has been announced yet.
